findings.text: tests/test_a_concurrent_launch_is_refused.py:884 asserts only the failing-rewrite outcome (pointer['reservation_supervisor_recorded'] is False); no case asserts that a rewrite which lands leaves the field off the pointer, so a mutation that publishes the field unconditionally in _record_supervisor_reporting (reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2608-2614) keeps every recorded case green, including the two-file gate at the head.

reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2611 writes reservation_supervisor_recorded: false onto the run's pointer, but no production code reads that field (git grep over reckon/ finds only the two writers at dispatch.py:3569 and here) and nothing clears it when a later launch for the same run records its supervisor successfully, so a stale false outlives the condition it describes.
